dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge displays a pronounced concave spline curvature, transitioning from a steep downward slope near the apex to a shallower curve at the posterior base, resulting in a distinct falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded with a small pixel radius, exhibiting a small V-shaped indentation or notch at the superior-posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a linear incline at an approximate 45 to 50-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum visible base width to the maximum vertical height of the fin is approximately 2.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible notch at the apex of the fin; distinct depigmented or scarred patch with irregular margins located at the posterior base near the trailing edge junction.
